description: Header file providing templates and function declarations for MKL Sparse BLAS operations within the at::mkl::sparse namespace, including create_csr, create_bsr, mv, add, export_csr, mm, spmmd, trsv, and trsm.

methods.name: create_csr
methods.description: Template function for creating CSR sparse matrix, not implemented for generic types.

methods.name: create_bsr
methods.description: Template function for creating BSR sparse matrix, not implemented for generic types.

methods.name: mv
methods.description: Template function for sparse matrix-vector multiplication, not implemented for generic types.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Template function for adding sparse matrices, not implemented for generic types.

methods.name: export_csr
methods.description: Template function for exporting CSR matrix data, not implemented for generic types.

methods.name: mm
methods.description: Template function for sparse matrix-matrix multiplication, not implemented for generic types.

methods.name: spmmd
methods.description: Template function for sparse matrix-matrix multiplication with dense output, not implemented for generic types.

methods.name: trsv
methods.description: Template function for solving triangular sparse systems, not implemented for generic types.

methods.name: trsm
methods.description: Template function for solving triangular systems with multiple right-hand sides, not implemented for generic types.
